newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Metro buys Bloch for 26 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Metro buys Bloch for 26 mln rand.

text.p: Metro Cash and Carry Ltd said on Tuesday it has acquired from Bloch Ltd its entire business consisting of the ownership and licensing of Bloch and related trademarks.
It also included 15 supermarkets in the Western and Eastern Cape which Metro has bought from the Rabinowitz family.
The total purchase consideration was around 26 million rand.
"The acquisition of the supermarkets gives us a solid base for a quick entry into the Western and Eastern Cape areas," managing director Carlos Dos Santos said in a statement.
Metro said the deal was effective May 1 and would have no material effect on its earnings per share or its net asset value.
The stores will be converted into IGA Friendly Grocer supermarkets, part of the Independent Grocers Alliance (IGA), the world's largest retail chain, the statement said.
